SELECT g.home_score, g.away_score, ht.name AS home_team, at.name AS away_team, g.date
FROM games g
JOIN teams ht ON ht.id = g.home_team_id
JOIN teams at ON at.id = g.away_team_id

WHERE s.id = (SELECT season_id FROM seasons ORDER BY end_date DESC LIMIT 1)
